desc:
🚽 Toilet Warfare Defense is a tower defense game where Screen Men, Amplifiermen and Camcordermen fight back against invading toilets!

⏩ NEW: 2x SPEED with the Speed pass! Join the group for FREE 1.5x speed!

🎉 RELEASE: the Release Pack's EARLY SUPPORTER title is only available until 25 November!

⚔️ Place your units and hold the line across the City and the Outskirts
💀 Go from Easy to Nightmare and take down bosses like the Boss Toilet and the Infected Titan Amplifierman
🎲 Summon units and hunt for rare Shinies
🧪 Evolve your units in the Research Sector
🤝 Trade units and items with other players
💤 Earn free rolls and research tokens in The Void
🏆 Daily rewards, quests, achievements and leaderboards
👥 Team up with friends or play solo

📱💻 Play on mobile and PC! 🎮 Console support soon

No exploits or macros. Cheaters get banned and farmed items removed. AFK? Use The Void!

👍 Like and favorite the game to get notified of new updates!
